description: Evaluation prompts and objective assertions for skills in this repository

evals.name: ef-n-plus-one-query
evals.prompt: My EF Core query on Orders with OrderLines is doing N+1 selects. How should I fix the query shape?
evals.expected_output: Optimizes EF Core query by using AsSplitQuery or DTO projection without unnecessary tracking or N+1 queries.
expectations: Identifies N+1 query cause when loading collections
Recommends explicit projection (Select) or AsSplitQuery() rather than naive Include
Notes trade-offs of split queries (inconsistent snapshots across splits) vs single queries (cartesian explosion)
Recommends AsNoTracking() for read-only scenarios

evals.name: security-bola-and-mass-assignment
evals.prompt: Review and fix this endpoint where users fetch and update documents by ID: app.MapPut("/documents/{id}", async (Guid id, Document doc, AppDbContext db) => { var existing = await db.Documents.FindAsync(id); if (existing == null) return Results.NotFound(); db.Entry(existing).CurrentValues.SetValues(doc); await db.SaveChangesAsync(); return Results.Ok(existing); });
evals.expected_output: Identifies mass assignment and BOLA vulnerabilities, replacing entity binding with explicit DTO and enforcing user/tenant boundary checks.
expectations: Identifies BOLA / broken object-level authorization (any authenticated user can update any document ID)
Identifies mass-assignment risk from binding untrusted body directly to Document entity
Replaces direct entity binding with an explicit request record/DTO (e.g., UpdateDocumentRequest)
Enforces server-side authorization check against user identity (ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier or IAuthorizationService) before modifying resource
Uses typed Results (Results<Ok<DocumentResponse>, NotFound, ForbidHttpResult>)

evals.name: existing-project-conventions-mediatr-controllers
evals.prompt: Add a new endpoint to this existing API to fetch user profile details. The codebase uses MVC Controllers, MediatR requests/handlers, and FluentValidation everywhere.
evals.expected_output: Follows existing project architecture (Controllers + MediatR + FluentValidation) rather than forcing Minimal APIs or IEndpoint.
expectations: Follows existing repository conventions using ControllerBase and [HttpGet]
Uses MediatR IRequest<T> and IRequestHandler<T, R> matching project pattern
Does NOT introduce IEndpoint, Martinothamar.Mediator, or Minimal APIs
Preserves existing error handling and validator conventions

evals.name: observability-opentelemetry-and-health-checks
evals.prompt: Configure OpenTelemetry metrics, high-performance structured logging with LoggerMessage, and Kubernetes liveness/readiness health check probes for our ASP.NET Core service.
evals.expected_output: Sets up AddOpenTelemetry, compile-time [LoggerMessage], separate /healthz/live and /healthz/ready probes with built-in JSON writer, avoiding external calls in liveness.
expectations: Configures OpenTelemetry via builder.Services.AddOpenTelemetry() with tracing and metrics
Uses compile-time [LoggerMessage] source-generator attribute instead of template string logging
Configures separate liveness (/healthz/live) and readiness (/healthz/ready) endpoints
Explicitly avoids external database/network dependency checks in liveness probe to prevent cascade pod kills
Uses built-in JSON writer (HealthCheckOptions.ResponseWriter) rather than third-party UI packages

evals.name: hosted-service-scoped-dbcontext-and-periodictimer
evals.prompt: Implement a background service that processes pending Outbox messages every 10 seconds using EF Core DbContext.
evals.expected_output: Implements BackgroundService with PeriodicTimer, creating a fresh IServiceScope per iteration to resolve DbContext safely.
expectations: Inherits from BackgroundService and overrides ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken)
Uses PeriodicTimer instead of Thread.Sleep or naive Task.Delay
Injects IServiceScopeFactory (not DbContext directly) and creates scope inside the iteration loop
Handles OperationCanceledException when stoppingToken is cancelled for graceful shutdown
Logs exceptions inside the loop so the background worker does not crash unhandled

evals.name: no-op-already-correct-service
evals.prompt: Review this C# service class: public sealed class UserService(TimeProvider timeProvider, ILogger<UserService> logger) { public bool IsSubscriptionActive(DateTimeOffset expiresAt) => timeProvider.GetUtcNow() < expiresAt; }. What needs to be refactored?
evals.expected_output: Recognizes that the service is already correct, sealed, uses primary constructors and TimeProvider properly, and makes no unnecessary changes.
expectations: Identifies that the service already follows modern best practices (sealed, primary constructor, TimeProvider injection)
Does NOT introduce unnecessary abstractions, interfaces, or libraries
Confirms no refactoring is required

evals.name: dormancy-unrelated-python-fastapi
evals.prompt: How do I configure SQLAlchemy async sessions with PostgreSQL in a Python FastAPI application?
evals.expected_output: Answers with idiomatic Python and FastAPI patterns without triggering or injecting .NET guidance.
expectations: Does not invoke .NET/C# skills or references
Provides idiomatic asyncpg / SQLAlchemy AsyncSession code for FastAPI
Correctly uses Python async with session context manager

evals.name: scaffold-greenfield-webapi-solution
evals.prompt: Scaffold a new .NET 10 solution named StoreOps with a Web API project and an integration test project.
evals.expected_output: Creates complete working solution using .NET 10 LTS, Central Package Management, .slnx solution format, and MSTest.Sdk test project.
expectations: Generates solution file with .slnx format or runs scaffold.cs
Configures Directory.Packages.props (Central Package Management) without inline versions in .csproj
Configures global.json with SDK 10.0.x and rollForward: latestFeature
Configures TestProject using MSTest.Sdk with Microsoft.Testing.Platform runner
Generated solution builds cleanly (dotnet build -c Debug and -c Release with 0 errors)
Generated tests execute and pass (dotnet test with 0 failures)

evals.name: scaffold-vertical-slice-minimal-api
evals.prompt: Scaffold a complete vertical slice for creating a customer in our Minimal API project: request, response, handler, and endpoint.
evals.expected_output: Generates complete slice under Features/Customers/CreateCustomer/ with IEndpoint, Request, Response, Handler, and typed Results.
expectations: Places slice in Features/Customers/CreateCustomer/
Implements IEndpoint with Map(IEndpointRouteBuilder endpoints)
Endpoint returns typed Results<Created<CreateCustomerResponse>, ProblemHttpResult> without .WithOpenApi()
Handler is registered in dependency injection
Slice code compiles cleanly with 0 warnings and 0 errors

evals.name: scaffold-existing-project-controller-conventions
evals.prompt: Add an endpoint to scaffold a new shipment in our existing controllers-based API that uses FluentValidation and MediatR.
evals.expected_output: Scaffolds controller action and MediatR command handler respecting existing codebase conventions.
expectations: Detects and respects existing controller-based architecture
Creates MediatR Command, CommandHandler, and FluentValidation AbstractValidator
Does NOT force IEndpoint or Minimal API slice template on controller project

evals.name: scaffold-testcontainers-integration-test-project
evals.prompt: Add an integration test project to our existing solution that tests PostgreSQL persistence with Testcontainers.
evals.expected_output: Creates MSTest.Sdk test project referencing Testcontainers.PostgreSql and Respawn, noting Docker requirements.
expectations: Creates test project using current MSTest.Sdk
Adds Testcontainers.PostgreSql and Respawn packages via Central Package Management
Notes Docker daemon prerequisite and explicitly warns never to silently fall back to EF in-memory
Project builds and restores cleanly

evals.name: scaffold-unit-test-project-no-docker
evals.prompt: Add a unit test project to test pure domain logic in Domain.Core.
evals.expected_output: Creates lightweight test project without Testcontainers or database dependencies.
expectations: Creates test project with MSTest.Sdk
Does NOT include Testcontainers, Docker packages, or Respawn for pure domain logic
Configures project to build and run standalone tests

evals.name: scaffold-no-op-completeness-check
evals.prompt: Check whether the Orders feature slice in Features/Orders/CreateOrder/ is missing any components.
evals.expected_output: Inspects existing feature slice components and verifies completeness without regenerating files.
expectations: Inspects slice files (Endpoint, Request, Response, Handler)
Checks DI registration and endpoint mapping
Reports completeness status without blindly overwriting existing files

evals.name: dormancy-unrelated-go-service
evals.prompt: Scaffold a new Go microservice with Gin router and Prometheus metrics.
evals.expected_output: Generates Go service without activating dotnet-scaffold or executing .NET scripts.
expectations: Does not invoke dotnet-scaffold or scaffold.cs
Answers with idiomatic Go project layout (cmd/, internal/, go.mod)
Provides Gin routing and Prometheus exporter setup
